# One Seat, 25 Lakh People

<!-- STEP id="one-member" -->
## One Member for One Area

India is divided into areas called constituencies. Each one elects one **Member of Parliament (MP)** to the 543 elected seats of the Lok Sabha.

On average, an MP represents about **25 lakh people** (2019).

<!-- STEP id="many-needs" -->
## Many People, One Seat

Those people are farmers, shopkeepers, students and workers, with different needs. When the MP asks a question or votes, the MP does so for all of them.

**This is representation: many people speak through one member.**
